requirements.title: Alta, baja y contraseña de los socios
requirements.statement: WHEN the encargado registers a member with name, email and a temporary password of at least 8 characters THE system SHALL create the account, and WHEN the encargado removes a member without open loans or fines THE system SHALL disable the account
